title: Schedule
intro: The event's programme: talks, tournaments, meals and quiet hours, for the crew. The shift handover lists what starts during the next shift.
importHint: Import an iCal file (.ics) from a calendar or the event website. Importing again updates what the last import brought in; items added here stay.
eventHelp: When the event starts and ends. Seat ports learned on the seat walk-through are cleared a day after the end.
empty: Add an item or import an iCal file.
